![](https://prod-tmforum.xperience-sites.com/getContentAsset/5ee30517-d8e6-42a0-a90e-f59a0dcc8c55/8d57b769-77e1-461e-aba0-6238959bed8f/Autonomous-networks_icon.png?language=en)

###### Accelerating the shift to Autonomous Network operations and management is a top priority for CTOs and network leaders across the connectivity industry.

Our Autonomous Networks Mission enables providers to reach Level 4 of AN maturity and beyond, unlocking benefits from increased velocity to reduced costs and better customer experience through a Highly Autonomous Network.  
Members are building an industry standard architecture that enables self-healing, self-optimizing network domains, readying the network for autonomous “Zero-X” (zero wait, zero touch, zero trouble) operations.

![Big data](/getContentAsset/c2e85239-2811-4f69-8294-78675627bf22/8d57b769-77e1-461e-aba0-6238959bed8f/FullWidthActualDesktop/shutterstock_2464093267.jpg?language=en)

### Assessing CSPs' progress towards Level 4 autonomous networks

Communications service providers (CSPs) globally are striving to reach high levels of autonomy in their networks, but just how successful have they been? Find out in our new report, which details their progress and the methodologies they are using to evaluate advancement.

[Assessing CSPs' progress towards Level 4 autonomous networks](https://inform.tmforum.org/research-and-analysis/reports/assessing-csps-progress-towards-level-4-autonomous-networks)

## Autonomous Network levels taxonomy

Autonomous networks (AN) promise to be transformative for communications service providers (CSPs), enabling them to operate more efficiently, deliver better customer experiences and innovate rapidly. TM Forum’s community sits at the center of an industry-wide collaboration to drive the uptake and evolution of AN technology, processes and the business models they enable.

TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks Project has developed a six-step taxonomy that CSPs can use to measure their AN progress. Each level has a set of characteristics describing the evolutionary stage of the CSP’s journey from fully manual to fully autonomous operations.

**Level 4** AN introduces decision-making based on intent-driven, predictive analysis, and the capability to perform closed-loop management of service-driven and customer experience-driven networks via AI modelling and continuous learning. Achieving these capabilities requires complex phases of technology change in CSPs’ networks.

This is a significant leap from **Level 3**, where machines assist humans in decision-making but still rely on human oversight. Today, most operators are between Levels 2 and 3, but some are moving rapidly towards Level 4 in certain domains.

[Autonomous networks: Level 4 industry blueprint](https://inform.tmforum.org/research-and-analysis/reports/autonomous-networks-level-4-industry-blueprint)

![AN Levels](/getContentAsset/d0467f92-de46-4884-82de-8e6f57a72296/8d57b769-77e1-461e-aba0-6238959bed8f/FullWidthMobile/Screenshot-2026-03-17-at-10-42-56.png?language=en)

![AN newsletter banner background](/getContentAsset/56266651-e938-4e8e-a7b1-ef232eb2ebca/8d57b769-77e1-461e-aba0-6238959bed8f/FullWidthActualDesktop/shutterstock_2544649971.jpg?language=en)

### CSPs Evaluation Results

See our table of AN Level validations for network operators who have agreed to share their results publicly. Many more operators are sharing the results of their AN Level assessments within the Autonomous Networks collaboration project, which is open for all TM Forum members to join.

[Autonomous Network Level Assessment Validations](https://www.tmforum.org/topics/an-resources/#levels)

## Autonomous Networks levels solutions

TM Forum research suggests AN maturity can result in up to a 55% reduction in operations and maintenance costs, a 71% rise in customer satisfaction and a 21% increase in energy savings, while also helping businesses reach their sustainability goals

The AN framework aims to provide a systematic method for operators from AN strategy planning to implementation, guiding them to carry out AN work more efficiently. The solution packs will include four key elements: AN levels, Key Effectiveness Indicators (KEIs), AN Target Architecture, and AN Map, along with operation practices, and industry assessment (ANLAV).

* **High value scenarios (HVS)**guide aims to direct the industry into which AN solutions to prioritize.
* **AN Level solution packs** are being developing across the matrix of domains and services needed for the CSPs to deliver automation based on the HVS that they want to adopt.
* **Autonomous Networks levels** (AN Levels) measure the level of autonomic capability in a given network scenario (for example: fault management on the radio access network, quality optimization on the IP network…). .
* **AN Level assessment validation** (ANLAV) TM Forum provides a service to independently scrutinise and validate that an that an operator’s Autonomous Network Level assessment has been carried out correctly according to the methodology.

[Explore Autonomous Networks levels solutions](https://www.tmforum.org/oda/solutions/anl-solution-packs)

## Start your journey

### Identify the latest AN trends

Identifying emerging trends and the relative challenges and opportunities is essential in the rapidly evolving AN space.

TM Forum’s research analysts regularly publish reports including our [AN Benchmark report](https://inform.tmforum.org/research-and-analysis/reports/autonomous-networks-in-search-of-best-practice) and [AN Level 4 industry blueprint](https://inform.tmforum.org/research-and-analysis/reports/an-level-4-industry-blueprint-high-value-scenarios-11-24), as well as case studies, C-level interviews, insights from industry figures and more.

[Read the latest insights](https://inform.tmforum.org/search?q=&page=1&order_by=newest&topics=Autonomous+networks&contentType=Research+Report)

### Accelerate innovation

[TM Forum’s Innovation Engine](https://www.tmforum.org/innovate) enables Members to experiment and deliver proof-of-concepts and reference code to extend AN maturity, increase monetization opportunities and deliver efficiency gains.

We're showcasing 25 AN-related Catalysts at DTW, from using [generative AI to automate network maintenance](https://www.tmforum.org/catalysts/projects/C24.0.676) to how to [unleash 5G monetization with autonomous operations](https://www.tmforum.org/catalysts/projects/C24.0.646/unleash-5g-monetization-with-autonomous-operations).

The Innovation Hub brings together the best industry talent to tackle specific challenges such as AN Level 4 RAN Fault Management and MBB Fault Management.

Hackathons such as the [Google Cloud AI: Autonomous networking challenge](https://dtw.tmforum.org/google-cloud-hackathon) are high energy, intense and exciting events.

[Explore innovation opportunities](https://www.tmforum.org/catalysts/projects?topics=Autonomous+networks&page=1)

### Build the standards

Our Member Collaboration projects transform the latest AN innovations and advances into pragmatic and usable standards, blueprints, toolkits and best practices that are incorporated into TM Forum’s overall ODA framework.

Teams from multiple organizations work together on projects covering topics such as using [AI to evolve closed-loop automation](https://www.tmforum.org/ai-closed-loop-automation) and [measuring and managing autonomy](https://www.tmforum.org/toolkits/measuring-managing-autonomy-toolkit/).

[View the latest collaboration projects](https://myaccount.tmforum.org/joinproject)

### Gain the knowledge to advance AN maturity

TM Forum’s education programs equip individual roles and entire teams with the skills and know-how to accelerate AN maturity while also supporting professional growth and career development.

Our dedicated Autonomous Network Levels (ANL) skill path explains how to use our standard methodology to determine your level of autonomy.

Related skills certification provides assurance that the required level competence has been reached.

[Explore our Education programs](https://www.tmforum.org/training-certification/course-catalog/?topic_tag=autonomous-networks#course-catalog)

### Evaluate, plan and validate your AN Levels progress

Our Autonomous Networks resources provide tools and guidance to evaluate, plan and validate your AN progress.

[Explore TM Forum's Autonomous Networks Levels](https://www.tmforum.org/topics/an-resources#levels)

### See the impact: Autonomous Networks in action

See how CSPs are unlocking benefits - from increased velocity to reduced costs and better customer experience - by implementing Autonomous Networks.

[Latest case studies](https://inform.tmforum.org/search?q=&page=1&order_by=newest&topics=Autonomous+networks&contentType=Case+Study)

### Meet up and join in at our industry events

Our Global Events are a platform to innovate, collaborate, and showcase real-world solutions to industry challenges. We have a range of inspiring events such as [DTW Ignite](https://www.tmforum.org/events/dtw) where you'll connect with other highly-engaged experts from the connectivity ecosystem.

Don't miss our upcoming event [TM Forum Tour, Tokyo](https://tour.tmforum.org/tokyo-japan/).

Collaborate face-to-face with your peers at [Accelerate](https://www.tmforum.org/events/accelerate "Follow link") to shape the future of Autonomous Networks.

[Check out our upcoming events](https://www.tmforum.org/tm-forum-events/)
